access.combinationsSay: 3 tenant roles × 3 docket roles × 4 operations = 36 role–operation combinations, each decided by one of three deciders: the user's roles, the x-qpu-role header, the entry's kind (textbook_access_combinations)

entries.read: everyone, but each group's kinds: their readers alone
entries.create: a call by any keyed user of the tenant, or through the Payload MCP (its address folds the call); an anonymous REST call is refused by the multi-tenant plugin's tenant assignment (measured 2026-10-26) and is computed at the Worker's /mcp instead, never stored; other kinds by a super admin, a tenant-admin or editor of the entry's tenant, or the tenant's writer token
entries.update: no one: an entry is its content address, so a change is a new entry
entries.delete: a super admin, a tenant-admin of the entry's tenant (a where on the tenant), or the tenant's admin token

access.users: the site's own (admin or self), with an API key per user for MCP clients
access.pages: the site's own access, kept (published pages public, drafts to users)
access.by: Payload's user, or a role header signed under the deployment's secret (x-qpu-role-mac: HMAC-SHA-256 over role|tenant|METHOD, roles.ts); a bare x-qpu-role header is no claim (measured 2026-10-26: unsigned, it let an anonymous request delete an entry)

checks.evidence: entries (but the operational kinds, read by their tenant) and tenants read by everyone; every tool answers without a credential
checks.hook: none: a read is served from the cache by address
checks.cost: free: a cache hit by address, a 304 by involution
checks.licence: BY: every answer carries _meta.license and the attribution
checks.legal: the moral right of attribution (Berne art. 6bis), honoured on every read

checks.evidence: an anonymous create is a call or a chat, whose address folds it as corrected for the role; any other kind needs a tenant role or a writer role signed under the deployment secret (a bare header is no claim)
checks.hook: beforeValidate: the content address on create, so a repeated call is the same row
checks.cost: paid once by the provider for the first computation, free after by address
checks.licence: NC: non-commercial use is free and needs no licence; the a432 default is priced 0
checks.legal: consideration: non-commercial free, commercial billed on the measured advantage

checks.evidence: no one updates an entry: a change is a new entry linked to the one it replaces
checks.hook: none on change: nothing cached under an address changes
checks.cost: free: no revalidation, ever
checks.licence: ND: no derivative of a sealed entry; the chain of entries is the history
checks.legal: integrity (Berne art. 6bis); the sui generis database right over the sealed ledger (Directive 96/9/EC art. 7)

checks.evidence: tenant-admin, editor, viewer over pages, entries, products, orders; reader, writer, admin over the docket
checks.hook: the multi-tenant plugin scopes every read and write by the user's tenants
checks.cost: free: a where on the tenant
checks.licence: the licence names the domains it covers; a tenant acts on its own
checks.legal: tenant isolation: one docket per tenant host; a token at another tenant's host holds no role

checks.evidence: a tenant-admin deletes within its tenant (a where), a signed admin role within its docket, a super admin anywhere
checks.hook: access.delete: the where is the hook
checks.cost: free: the where is evaluated by the database
checks.licence: the licence's domains bound the act
checks.legal: accountability: a deletion is a role's, named by the token or the user

checks.evidence: tenants are created, updated and deleted by a super admin alone
checks.cost: free
checks.licence: the licence is per domain: a tenant row is a licensed domain
checks.legal: the operator answers for the tenants it names

checks.evidence: the tenant admin selects binding names (profile, connectors, variables); a value is refused by the field
checks.cost: free
checks.licence: the licence names the domain, the bindings name the providers: nothing secret in Payload
checks.legal: privacy by data minimisation: no secret, no personal datum in the tree or the admin

checks.evidence: the machine tool of the Payload MCP runs only on a loopback host for a super admin, an argument vector the allow-list planned handed to the one runner (scripts/machine.ts, spawn with no shell) and never a process of its own, every run created as the user
checks.cost: free
checks.licence: the developer's own machine, under the licence
checks.legal: nothing leaves the machine but what the user confirms: a push needs confirm and the pre-push rules

checks.evidence: the first user comes from the deployer's account at deploy; no address in the generated code
checks.cost: free
checks.licence: the author is attributed by ORCID and URL, never by an address
checks.legal: no personal datum kept in the tree: the deployer's address is read at deploy, never written

checks.evidence: the admin role has access to every tenant; everyone else acts in its tenants
checks.cost: free
checks.licence: the operator holds the licence catalogue: a domain licence is an order of its ecommerce
checks.legal: the operator is the author or the party the author licensed

checks.evidence: every user may hold an API key; the Payload MCP plugin refuses an anonymous request
checks.cost: free
checks.licence: a key is a user's of a licensed tenant
checks.legal: accountability: every write over the app's MCP is a user's

checks.evidence: 47 tools, every one read-only and idempotent; credential-named arguments: stripe.secret (the Worker passes it at the edge)
checks.hook: none: the tools are pure functions of their arguments
checks.cost: free: a 304 by involution needs no scope at all
checks.licence: BY: the a432 default free to all under attribution
checks.legal: no credential travels through a tool from a client; where the Worker passes one at the edge, a client never holds it

checks.evidence: the advantage is computed from the run's counts alone: when every copy is an involution it is unbounded; the metrics tool takes artefacts and nothing else
checks.hook: none: the gate decodes, the involution answers 304, the metric follows
checks.cost: free: no approval, no token, no bound (textbook_advantage_unbounded)
checks.licence: the advantage is what commercial use is billed on, and what non-commercial use gets free
checks.legal: consideration measured by the unit (bill_call), recheckable by anyone

checks.evidence: the entry id is the content address of { kind, from, body }, the sha256 beside it, on create only

checks.licence: ND: an entry is its content
checks.legal: integrity: the address is the proof

checks.cost: free: folded from the document the hook already holds
checks.licence: ND: no silent overwrite of anyone's edit
checks.legal: integrity of concurrent authorship

checks.evidence: an app request is validated as it is typed and refused by the hook when the stream refused it
checks.cost: free: validated token free
checks.licence: commercial: the app is priced by the catalogue and ordered through the ecommerce plugin
checks.legal: a licence sold is an order with its terms

checks.evidence: every tools/call result carries _meta.license; initialize states the terms
checks.cost: free
checks.licence: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0: Attribute the author; do not distribute a derivative; commercial use of the QPU framework, over UUID or by any other means, requires a licence from the author (https://qpu.uuidna.com). The a432 harmonic default is offered for free benefit under attribution. Every block carries its address and its SHA-256: a copy that no longer matches them is adapted material, which the NoDerivatives term does not let anyone share.
checks.legal: the licence is the contract every reader accepts by reading; its address is sealed (9ffcda04-5adc-872e-9358-6b831bbd0c0d)

checks.evidence: the a432 harmonic default at 0 on every domain; a named domain licensed by the year
checks.hook: the ecommerce plugin: products, variants, orders
checks.cost: free to read, paid to license
checks.licence: NC and commercial: the catalogue is the licence
checks.legal: consideration: non-commercial free and needing no licence; commercial billed

checks.evidence: the licence entry stores event, type, state, subject, tenant, domains, product, variant, quantity, customer, amount, currency, at, licence, terms: the customer a Stripe id, no name, address, card or identity document
checks.hook: the stripe tool: the webhook verified before anything is written, the entry the licence
checks.cost: free: the identity and the payment data never enter the tree
checks.licence: all non-harmonic use licensed over MCP by billable automation: the licence is the order, the order is Stripe's checkout
checks.legal: GDPR and KYC are Stripe's: the customer's identity and payment data live at Stripe under its DPA and its account verification; the tree keeps the order, the tenant and the domains

checks.evidence: recomputable facts, not legal advice; the work represented by its canonical site only

checks.licence: the disclaimer travels with the licence
checks.legal: the inputs a qualified attorney starts from, never the conclusion
